title: Choose the Inquest Workspace Architecture
question: Select the structural and interactive direction for the Nymbus Inquest Chat & Task Progress Workspace. Consistent with The Spatial Ledger.

options.label: The Dual-Track Inquest Ledger
options.thesis: Synchronized two-lane workspace: Dialogue & verified findings on the left lane, live 5-agent execution telemetry & subtask DAG on the right lane.
options.viewport: Left 260px history ledger; Center split-stream (dialogue lane + live agent subtask execution stream); Top agent conveyor
options.case: Maximum transparency: researchers observe agent tool calls, subtask transitions, and passage digests unfolding beside the synthesized findings in real-time without obscuring conversation.
options.risk: Requires two columns on desktop; cleanly stacks or tabs on mobile viewports.
options.body: A synchronized dual-track workspace where conversation and multi-agent execution telemetry advance in lockstep side by side.

options.label: The Modular Canvas Ledger
options.thesis: Top 3D/Isometric micro-DAG progress ribbon showing active subtask decomposition, stacked above expandable intelligence dossier cards.
options.viewport: Left categorized domain folders; Top 3D subtask wireframe ribbon; Middle stacked finding cards with inline source highlights
options.case: Direct visual continuity with The Spatial Ledger 3D plane from the landing page, rendered as a persistent micro-DAG progress header above structured cards.
options.risk: Cards consume vertical height if many tool actions run simultaneously.
options.body: An architectural notebook format featuring an isometric task progress ribbon and modular intelligence findings.

options.label: The Integrated Forensic Stream
options.thesis: Single unified chronological timeline where prompts, real-time agent execution traces, and verified conclusion cards flow seamlessly in one continuous feed.
options.viewport: Left cryptographic session tree; Middle unified forensic rail with ticking subtasks; Bottom floating prompt dock
options.case: Zero visual overhead: pure chronological flow where subtasks tick complete in place, creating an immutable audit trail without window clutter.
options.risk: Very dense text flow requiring strong typography and clear state indicators.
options.body: A pure chronological forensic rail where multi-agent subtasks and synthesized evidence flow seamlessly in an unbroken audit log.
